# P4-01 — Close the endpoint contract (with correction 9)

## Endpoints added or brought into line with the frontend
| Frontend annotation | Backend route |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/qcompass/domains/{domain}/runs` | `list_runs`: newest first, `limit`/`offset`, `RunSummary[]` (from stored sidecars until P3-03) |
| `GET /api/qcompass/domains/{domain}/runs/{id}` | now returns the frontend's `DomainRunResult` (`qcompass_core.wire`), not the raw sidecar |
| `GET/POST /api/qcompass/scans`, `GET /api/qcompass/scans/{id}` | the scan routes are mounted under `/api/qcompass/scans`; `/api/scans` stays as the alias |
| `GET /api/qcompass/tenants` | the caller's tenants (`Tenant[]`); P3-04 extends it to `tenant_members` |
| `GET /api/qcompass/verdict` | the latest verdict (`VerdictSample`), Supabase admin only |
| `GET /api/qcompass/literature/lattice-qcd`, `/nuclear` | the reference lists (`LiteratureReference[]`) |
| *(correction 9)* `GET /api/verdict/{id}` | verdict by id, Supabase admin only; the page now fetches this |

- **Domain ids in paths:** paths accept the frontend's full `DomainId` (`hep.lattice`, …) and the short names (`hep`, …). The response always carries the full id.
- **Correction 9, admin gate (`m8_agent/supabase_auth.py`):**
  - The Supabase access token is verified against the project JWKS (`{SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json`).
  - Accepted algorithms are ES256/RS256 only, with `aud=authenticated`, `iss={SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1`, and required `exp`/`sub`.
  - The role comes from `public.user_roles`, fetched over PostgREST with the caller's own token, so RLS applies. The service-role key is never used.
  - Missing `SUPABASE_URL`/`SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` gives 503 `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<NAME>` (R9).
- **Correction 9, data:** verdict data moved from `public/fixtures/verdict/` to `backend/src/ucgle_f1/m8_agent/data/verdicts/` (`sample.yaml`, `sample.md`). `sample-verdict.yaml.json` is removed; the page fetches from the API instead. `QCOMPASS_VERDICT_DIR` can point elsewhere.
- **Correction 9, page:** `src/services/qcompass/verdict.ts` fetches `GET /api/verdict/{id}` with the Supabase session's access token and has no static fallback. `admin.verdict.tsx` gains an error state (it previously showed "Loading…" forever on failure).

## Tests
- `backend/tests/test_frontend_contract.py`, 41 tests:
  - Every one of the 14 `@endpoint` annotations in `src/services/**/*.ts` has a route with the same method (SSE→GET, WS→WebSocket).
  - All 22 run fixtures validate against the GET-run route's own `response_model` and round-trip unchanged.
  - The run-list model accepts the fixtures' summaries.
  - The tenants fixture validates.
  - The backend's literature copies equal the frontend fixtures and validate.
  - The verdict data validates.
  - No verdict data remains under `public/fixtures`.
- `backend/tests/test_verdict_api.py`, 13 tests, with locally generated ES256 keys and fake JWKS/role fetchers (no network, R8):
  - admin → 200 (by id and latest);
  - signed-out → 401; non-admin → 403;
  - wrong key, expired, wrong audience, wrong issuer and unknown key id → 401;
  - HS256 and `none` → 401;
  - missing `SUPABASE_URL` → 503 `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:SUPABASE_URL`;
  - unsafe id → 400; unknown id → 404.
- **DoD "an unauthenticated GET of the old static path returns 404":** `e2e/verdict-admin-gate.spec.ts` checks each of `/fixtures/verdict/sample-verdict.{yaml.json,yaml,md}` on both production Worker builds (6 tests).
